rules.statement: The gain derived from the sale of treasury bonds would not attract income tax as 'profits and income' or 'profit' or 'income' under section 3(a) of the IRA 2006.
rules.supporting_quote: For those reasons, I hold that the gain derived by the Appellant from the sale of treasury bonds, would not attract income tax as “profits and income” or “profit” or “income” under section 3(a) of the IRA 2006.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 3(a) of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 10 of 2006
